qualityGate.reason: The TypeScript code compiles without errors and Playwright APIs are used correctly with proper awaiting of all assertions. The test covers the visibility of 26 product cards on the home page, matching the specified test case ID in the title. However, the use of repetitive individual selectors for each product card could be improved for maintainability and reusability. Selectors based on data-test attributes are strong and explicit, reducing flakiness. No asynchronous or API misuse was detected. The absence of more meaningful assertions beyond visibility and lack of navigation or deeper content validations limits assertion strength. The test is straightforward but could be improved by implementing loops, parameterization, or helper methods to avoid redundancy.
